## Description

Add leave (from, to, reason) or one-off exceptions (extra session, shortened day). Before saving, the system lists booked patients in the range; reception chooses to offer new slots (sends rebooking message with link/phone) or reschedule manually. Leave is saved only after each affected appointment has an action.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Saving leave that overlaps booked appointments shows the count and list and requires an action per appointment before save.
- [ ] **AC2.** Affected patients receive a rebooking message (no clinical details) and the appointments move to "needs rebooking" on the board.
- [ ] **AC3.** Extra sessions create bookable slots for that day only.
- [ ] **AC4.** Leave and exceptions are audited.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
